job: Show a colour that is content, such as a brand colour or a series colour.
purpose: A small square of a colour that belongs to the product's data, not to the theme. The colour comes from --fd-swatch-color, passed with data-fd-vars so no style attribute is needed. A checkerboard shows through translucent colours, data-empty marks no colour, and a button swatch with aria-pressed chooses one.
useWhen: A brand, series or tag colour appears beside its name or hex value.
People choose one colour from a short list.

avoidWhen.when: A status or a theme tone.
The person must enter a colour.

variants.useWhen: Beside a label in a list.
A preview of the brand colour.
A dot rather than a square.

parts.role: The colour; a span, or a button when it can be chosen.

keyboard.does: On a button swatch, choose it.
